title: Blueprints can be changed from the CLI and the web view
description: Today a blueprint is changed by editing .heist/blueprints/KIND.json by hand. Add commands to expect a section, drop one, set the description template and reset to the built-in, and a Blueprints page in the web view that does the same. A section that does not exist as a field yet is created as a project field in the same step. Outside the happy path: an unknown kind or field type is refused with the allowed values; dropping the last section is allowed; a reset of a blueprint that was never changed says so; saving in the web view while the file changed on disk shows the newer state instead of overwriting silently.
why: The owner wants to shape what a ticket should say without editing JSON, and agents should be able to assist from the CLI.

acceptance.text: A section can be added, changed, moved and removed from the CLI
The same is possible in the web view
A new section becomes a field that tickets can fill and the ticket page shows
Reset returns to the built-in blueprint
Nothing in .heist has to be edited by hand

todos.text: API: save, expect, drop, template and reset on project.blueprints
CLI: heist blueprint expect, drop, template, reset
New section creates the project field and expects it in one step
HTTP routes for reading one blueprint, saving and resetting
Blueprints page in the web view

outcome.summary: Blueprint sections can be added, changed, moved, removed and reset from the CLI and on the Blueprints page. A new section creates its project field in the same step.
outcome.verifiedBy: node --test: 77 pass, 1 skipped; Blueprints page run in headless Chromium on Linux (new section, reorder, template, save). Not checked on Windows.
